item.title: Basic guide to Linux customization
item.description: If you know a little bit about Linux and you’ve used the command line and package managers before but haven’t really gotten into customizing your system, then this article might be for you.

item.title: About
item.description: I’m Filip! I was born in 2003 and I’m a Computer Science student at Lodz University of Technology in Poland. This semester, I’m going to be writing my Bachelor’s thesis! I’m very interested in programming, GNU/Linux, Neovim, chess, speedcubing and coffee. I write articles about my passions to share some useful things I learned. I also post progress reports on my ongoing projects here. Unfortunately, interesting things take time to build so please bear with me :).
